findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Closure.lean:104 `theorem interior_inter : interior (s ∩ t) = interior s ∩ interior t`; mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Maps/Basic.lean:446 `theorem preimage_interior_eq_interior_preimage (hf₁ : IsOpenMap f) (hf₂ : Continuous f) (s : Set Y) : f ⁻¹' interior s = interior (f ⁻¹' s)`; mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Constructions/SumProd.lean:481 `theorem isOpenMap_fst`; mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Order/DenselyOrdered.lean:120 `theorem interior_Iic [NoMaxOrder α] : interior (Iic a) = Iio a`; mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Banach.lean:268 `theorem interior_preimage (hsurj : Surjective f) (s : Set F) : interior (f ⁻¹' s) = f ⁻¹' interior s`.
findings.fix: Write `kinematicDomain S` as the intersection of its four constraint sets and compute: `interior_inter` distributes interior over the intersection; the two strict constraints are open (`isOpen_lt`, `IsOpen.interior_eq`); `{z | z.1 ≤ 1} = Prod.fst ⁻¹' Iic 1` has interior `Prod.fst ⁻¹' Iio 1` by `isOpenMap_fst.preimage_interior_eq_interior_preimage continuous_fst` plus `interior_Iic`; and `{z | z.2 ≤ z.1 * S}` is the `Iic 0`-preimage of the surjective `L := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ - S • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ` (surjective: `fun a => ⟨(0, a), by simp⟩`), so its interior is `{z | z.2 - z.1 * S < 0}` by `ContinuousLinearMap.interior_preimage` plus `interior_Iic`. Delete `key`.
findings.issue: The ⊆ direction of `interior_kinematicDomain` re-derives the interior of the two closed constraints from scratch via a hand-built `key : ∀ v : ℝ × ℝ, ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ z + t • v ∈ kinematicDomain S` using `Tendsto`/`nhdsWithin`/`mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds` (lines 104-125). Mathlib already computes this.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn in_unitInterval code` returns only the two definitions at Bounds.lean:62 and :66 — no uses anywhere; their bodies (Bounds.lean:64, :68) are one-line conjunctions of the preceding lemmas, and Domain.lean:200/213 call those lemmas directly instead.
findings.fix: Delete both lemmas; callers with a `BasicAssumptions g K` apply `xBj_pos`/`xBj_le_one`/`yInel_pos`/`yInel_le_one` to its fields, exactly as `Domain.lean:200` and `Domain.lean:213` already do.
findings.issue: After this PR generalised `xBj_pos`/`xBj_le_one`/`yInel_pos`/`yInel_le_one` to take explicit hypotheses, `xBj_in_unitInterval` (line 62) and `yInel_in_unitInterval` (line 66) are literally `⟨xBj_pos g K h.q2_pos h.p_dot_q_pos, xBj_le_one g K h.p_dot_q_pos h.q2_le_two_p_dot_q⟩` and the `yInel` analogue — ∧-bundles of the four lemmas directly above them, with no in-repo consumer.

summary: The material itself is new and reuses the existing DIS invariants well, but the `interior_kinematicDomain` proof hand-rolls the interior of its closed constraints instead of using Mathlib's `interior_inter`/open-map preimage lemmas, and the two `*_in_unitInterval` lemmas the PR rewrites are now bare ∧-bundles of the lemmas just above them with no users.
